It downloads its files from the internet as it runs, and those servers refuse now and then, so trying again in a few minutes often works. The full output is in Highball's logs folder, in the newest file with winetricks in its name.

It ran with %@. Another mode often suits a game better on this Mac, and old DirectX 9 games in particular do badly on Wine's own Direct3D. This changes the mode for this game only; the environment keeps its own. Undo it any time under Advanced on the game's page.

Its last run asked Windows for a fullscreen size this Mac did not switch to. That is what leaves a game small in a corner, or with the mouse landing away from what it draws. Highball can have Wine report the change as done and scale the game to the screen instead. This game only; undo it under Advanced on its page.
